About Me

Professional Bio

Hi, I'm Muhammad Waseem Akram, a passionate Full-Stack Web Developer and final-year BS Computer Science student at COMSATS University Islamabad, Vehari Campus (Reg No. FA23-BCS-039).

I build modern, scalable and user-friendly web applications — from my final-year project MathQuest, an interactive Grade 1 mathematics learning platform covering the full Punjab textbook, to live products like CadetToCSP and EventFlow. I work across the stack with React, TypeScript, Node.js, Express and PostgreSQL, and I deploy real, working software to GitHub and Vercel.

Mission

To build scalable digital products that solve real-world problems elegantly.

Vision

To grow into an industry-leading software engineer who ships products people rely on.
